# Third-party notices

## @huggingface/jinja 0.5.10

- Package: @huggingface/jinja (https://github.com/huggingface/huggingface.js/tree/main/packages/jinja), a JavaScript port of Jinja for chat templates.
- Version: 0.5.10
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/jinja@0.5.10/dist/index.js (114210 bytes, sha256 `58cf1a55f9a48154a05bcb8d5b85d0dadfc96aef22fd33f3105ec2151e8bac36`); license from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/jinja@0.5.10/LICENSE
  (sha256 `d6e7b19451c1b3d1d66353bb4b1274138953b3bfd9ae60c56e77b1f548796982`).
- Vendored as `wasm/vendor/hfjinja.js`, generated by `wasm/vendor_jinja.py`: the dist's trailing
  `export` block is removed and the body is wrapped in a function that assigns `HFJinja`
  (Template, Environment, Interpreter, parse, tokenize) to the global scope, so the Web Worker (a classic script started from a
  blob: URL) and Node can load it. `wasm/make_artifact.py` prepends it to the worker bundle.
- Local patches (applied by the generator, in this order):
1. **strip-chars**: str.strip(), lstrip() and rstrip() ignore their characters argument (huggingface.js issue #2597, fix PR #2598 unreleased as of 2026-10-16); Qwen3's template uses rstrip('\n') and lstrip('\n') on reasoning content, so the browser rendered spaces around <think> blocks differently from Python.
2. **strftime-c-locale**: strftime_now supports only %Y %m %d %b %B %H %M %% and takes month names from the browser's locale (Intl.DateTimeFormat: '16 Okt 2026' under de-DE), while Python's datetime.strftime uses the C locale and the full directive set; templates that call strftime_now (SmolLM3 '%d %B %Y', gpt-oss '%Y-%m-%d', Llama 3.2 '%d %b %Y') must render the same prompt in every browser.
